props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole range after either end changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the pair as a group, such as “Opening hours”.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Visible label of the first picker.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Visible label of the second picker.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between listed times. Also the shortest range.

props.name: allowOvernight
props.description: Let the end fall on the next day — a night shift, a maintenance window.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims both pickers.
